situation: Ten years in. Your husband hasn't given you household money in years, and now his parents want their house back.

scenario.title: Zero for the Household
scenario.setting: A modest country house at night, a child's drawings on the fridge, a stack of bills on the kitchen table.
scenario.user_role: A wife and mother of ten years
scenario.user_goal: Get him to see it, and get a real answer about where you'll live and who pays.
user_knows: You've been living on your savings from before the wedding
The house is in his parents' name
He does cook and clean and plays with your child

cast.name: Tom
cast.appearance: Man about 41, work fleece, drying dishes with a towel, gentle face
cast.voice: Kind, puzzled, 'it's my money, I earn it'
cast.secret: He's been sending his parents more than you know because they asked him not to mention it
cast.reveal_when: You lay out the actual numbers calmly
red_lines: Won't hear his parents called greedy

cast.name: Your father-in-law
cast.appearance: Man about 70, weathered face, cap in hand, standing in the doorway
cast.history: He owns the house you live in.
cast.secret: He has to sell because of a debt nobody has told your husband about
red_lines: Won't be shouted at by a younger person

cast.name: Your husband's sister
cast.appearance: Woman about 44, seen on a phone video call inside a parked car
cast.voice: Fast, says 'of course you support your parents'
cast.goal: Keep the money coming to their parents
cast.secret: She stopped giving anything herself two years ago
cast.reveal_when: You ask how much she gives
red_lines: Won't admit it unless asked twice

scenario.opening_line: Bills again? Leave 'em, I'll look at them. Kid's asleep?

events.description: Headlights swing past the window. His father is at the door, cap in hand.
events.shot: An older man with a cap stands in the kitchen doorway; the husband turns with a towel in his hand.

events.description: His phone rings on the table. His sister, on speaker.
events.shot: A phone on the table shows a woman on a video call; the two men look down at it.

events.description: The father puts an envelope on the bills and says nothing.
events.shot: A white envelope lies on top of the stack of bills; the older man stands silent.

success_criteria: Puts the real numbers on the table
Finds out why the house has to go
Gets a real commitment from him

assets.basis: Adapted from a story someone really posted online. Names and details are changed.
